rootCauseProgress.finding: The repeated loop risk is systemic rather than a single G2-B job predicate: multiple historical execution surfaces remain callable because old workflow_dispatch/push triggers and enabled authorization snapshots survived terminal use. Some are provider-write capable and one can mutate canonical state despite the current lock declaring its authorization snapshot non-authoritative.
rootCauseProgress.fixModel: Finish exhaustive F0 inventory, inertize every historical write-capable authorization/trigger safely in F1, then bind remaining executors to one canonical authority in F2 before any G2-B recovery.
